instruction: Remodel a mixed retail and office building from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Remodel the starting building as a two-storey mixed retail and office building, then export the IFC4 model to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and an area schedule to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, four IfcSpace objects, eight IfcWall elements, and two IfcSlab elements. Name the spaces so they include at least two Retail spaces and two Office spaces. The final IFC should not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcStair, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The CSV must have exactly the headers category,area and two data rows: retail,95 and office,95. The init file is only a starting model; nonessential layout details may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
